title: Labor and Parts fields at rest and on hover look as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design pictures "card-09-n1-added.png" (board 1.9), "card-10-n1-added-hover.png" (board 1.10) and "card-11-n1-labor-list.png" (board 1.11) attached to this case are open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its card shows "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts", both reading {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in that browser window.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Without hovering, compare the two fields with the picture of board 1.9.
  2. Hover over the rows and compare with the picture of board 1.10.
  3. Click "Sales Representative - Labor" and compare the open list with the picture of board 1.11.
  4. Close the list, set the browser zoom to 200% and look at the two labels.
  5. Set the zoom back to 100%, make the window 1536 px wide and repeat steps 1 and 2.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Sales Representative - Labor" above "Sales Representative - Parts", both labels in full, plain at rest, with 16 px between all fields, as in the picture.
  • Step 2: both boxes show at once; each arrow sits in the bottom-right corner of its field, on the name line; the remove x (32 px, 20 px x icon, grey) beside Parts only; nothing beside Labor; no +.
  • Step 3: the list opens under Labor, "Unassigned" first, as in the picture; the person on the Parts row is not hidden.
  • Step 4: both labels still show in full, never cut off, and no arrow covers a label.
  • Step 5: the same look, nothing overlapping.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative), story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S1-R6: “The vertical gap between Lead Technician, Service Advisor and every Sales Representative field on the card is 16px. This holds with one field, with the Labor and Parts fields (S2-R5), and on the read-only card (S2-R17).”
  • S1-R11: “The dropdown arrow sits at the right end of the field, vertically centered on the label and the name together, the same as on Lead Technician and Service Advisor. With the Labor and Parts fields showing (S2-R5), the arrow sits instead in the bottom-right corner of each field, on the name line, so it never covers the longer label on a narrow or zoomed screen.”
  • S2-R5: “Picking "Sales Representative - Parts" closes the menu and replaces the one field with two fields, in this order: "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts".”
  • S2-R8: “A remove x sits to the right of "Sales Representative - Parts", in the column the + uses: the same Tertiary button, 32px square, showing the Lucide x icon at 20px, grey at rest with a light fill on hover.”
  • S2-R10: “While the two fields show, the + is not shown, because there is nothing left to add. "Sales Representative - Labor" has no button beside it.”
  • S2-R14: “Both labels show in full on the card, never cut off.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 1.9 Parts added: both rows copy Becky; 1.10 Hover: two rows; 1.11 Labor: pick who sold the labor (the attached pictures are these boards).

Design pictures attached to this case: card-09-n1-added.png, card-10-n1-added-hover.png, card-11-n1-labor-list.png.

  • Design — board 1.9 title: “1.9 Parts added: both rows copy Becky”
  • Design — board 1.9 note: “Two rows, "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts", both reading Becky Gonzales: the added row starts with the person the work order already credits (decision 65), so adding it alone moves no credit. No list opens on its own. Labels show in full. Measured gaps: 16px, 16px, 16px.”
  • Design — board 1.10 title: “1.10 Hover: two rows”
  • Design — board 1.10 note: “Both boxes show at once, each with its arrow. With Labor and Parts showing, the arrow sits on the name line in the bottom corner (decision 70). The + is gone (nothing left to add); the Parts row has a grey x beside it that removes the row.”
  • Design — board 1.11 title: “1.11 Labor: pick who sold the labor”
  • Design — board 1.11 note: “With Labor and Parts showing, the arrow sits on the name line in the bottom corner (decision 70). Each row has the same list: Unassigned first, then the reps. A person already on the other row is not hidden (decision 67).”
